title: Fantastic Day in Cordoba
text: Cordoba is an amazing city, and we really enjoyed our visit. The tour operator did an excellent job with communication, and made the trip from Seville very easy. Our guide, Carmen, was extremely knowledgeable and an absolute delight. Our only regret is that we didn’t opt for the later train back so that we had more time to explore the historic area and to take advantage of the restaurant recommendations.
author: Sharon_P

title: Delightful, Easy Day in Cordoba!
text: Matias set up a wonderful day for us in Cordoba! His prompt, clear and friendly  communication about everything made setting this up a joy! He made easy logistical arrangements for us, and he arranged for a fantastic private guide, Lola, for us to explore beautiful old town and its stunning mosque-cathedral (Mezquita-Catedral)! Lola is super knowledgeable, friendly, and was tuned in to our needs before we were (including the need for an helado (ice cream) along the way!)! She also provided great ideas for how we could spend the rest of our time in Cordoba! Gracias Matias y Lola!
author: kdunnewald

title: Just a fantastic way to see Cordoba
text: This tour was a smash hit for us. Everything and I mean everything was so well organised. We received the train tickets and constant follow up for our journey to Cordoba from Seville. Once there our guide Inma was nothing short of brilliant. Who knew this city and the magnificent mosque/Cathedral could enthral us for nearly 3 hours….so very worthwhile…and the train home was fantastic as well…
author: 530jackiep

title: Inma was very...
text: Inma was very knowledgeable about Cordoba and the mesquita.  You could tell she has a passion for history.  She also had a great sense of humor and did her best to engage my 16 and 12 year olds in the tour by telling jokes and asking them questions.  Would highly recommend.
author: Cecilia_C

title: Day touring Cordoba
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our private guided tour through Cordoba!  Elena was very personable and animated and very informative!  She told us things and showed us places we never would have seen or known had we just wandered the city ourselves. We would highly recommend!!
author: Daydream14531055874

title: Tour of Cordova
text:
Thankyou for a fabulous tour. It was such an easy train trip from Seville. Elena is an amazing guide with so much knowledge that she conveys in an interesting and relatable way, making for a very enjoyable tour. 
We left feeling we had learnt so much and would highly recommend her. Matias was always very helpful with organising the tour and kept us well informed so that everything went very smoothly.

title: Safe, happy
text: Thanks for this visit! They recommended this Enterprise, made us feel like friends, something very important when you travel outside your country. Thanks again.

title: Comfort, tranquility, kindness, very grateful
text: Service and excellent care, our guide was perfectly knowledgeable about the city, made us feel at home we will definitely repeat with Yannat in future visits.
